narrative_summary: The joke escalates from mundane hiring to Munder Difflin's actual product — a 'GOD orchestrator' managing encrypted AI clones of every employee — as the peak of galaxy-brained over-engineering.
rationale: Candidate 4 earns its escalation by grounding each panel in real product details — actual model names, the 'GOD orchestrator' branding, encrypted clones — so the galaxy-brain peak feels earned rather than exaggerated, and the template is a perfect structural match for a joke whose entire logic is 'this keeps getting more unhinged.' The trade-offer candidates all flatten the same irony into a single beat; the expanding-brain format lets the absurdity compound, which is where the laugh actually lives.
